note: Registered multi-send / disperse contracts and programs. A wallet funded through one of these is credited to the tx sender (multisend); any other contract that carries the coin is itself the funder and is excluded. Add an entry only after checking it on chain (source + date). EVM contracts are also recognised by the Disperse selectors in lib/onchain/origin.ts (disperseEther / disperseToken / disperseTokenSimple), so this list may stay short.
